data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'pera' meaning rock and 'ike' meaning likeness or resemblance. This name signifies a precious and strong personality, reminiscent of a steadfast and enduring rock. The name Perice carries the meaning “Rock, Precious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Perice usually hope their child will grow to embody rock, precious and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.long_meaning: The name ‘Perice’ in Greek is derived from the word ‘perissos’, which means ‘abundance, overflowing, profusion, excess’. This name is not directly found in the New Testament, but it is used in the Septuagint to translate the Hebrew name ‘Peretz’ (Joshua 15:32, Judges 9:46).

in_latin.name: Pericis
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name ‘Pericis’ is derived from the Latin word ‘pericis’, which means ‘fruitful’. It is not directly found in the Latin Vulgate, but it can be derived from the Greek or Hebrew names ‘Perissos’ or ‘Perets’.

in_english.name: Perice
in_english.long_meaning: The name ‘Perice’ in English is derived from the Latin word ‘pericis’, which means ‘fruitful’. It is not directly found in the English Bible, but it can be derived from the Latin or Greek names ‘Pericis’ or ‘Perissos’.
